title: missing composite index for unread_count correlated subquery
description: The unread_count correlated subquery in ChatStore::list() (kith-store/src/chat.rs lines 186-193) filters on chat_id, delivery_state='received', and read_at IS NULL. The only applicable index is messages_chat_time(chat_id, created_at), which allows a seek by chat_id but requires scanning all messages for that chat to filter on delivery_state and read_at. The same applies to unread_count() called from get() and find_direct_by_contact_id(). Adding a composite index on messages(chat_id, delivery_state, read_at) or a partial index on messages(chat_id) WHERE delivery_state='received' AND read_at IS NULL would eliminate the per-chat row scan and keep Chat/get and Chat/query fast as message history grows.
